purpose: Find wanted vinyl editions, compare legitimate acquisition opportunities, and later package the same research as a buyer-intent service.
hard_truth: A listing is an opportunity, not a saving or profit. Purchase, receipt, condition, edition identity and final landed cost must be evidenced.

source_policy.trademe: do_not_build_buyer_side_api_aggregation_without_explicit_approval; current API use-case guidance excludes buyer-side tools and price-monitoring/aggregation
source_policy.manual_web_research: allowed when performed through permitted public access and source terms are respected

service_ladder.name: Holy Grail Hunt
service_ladder.deliverable: edition-verified shortlist with landed NZD costs and source links
